name: Spanish Common Words Set 11
description: This is part of a larger set of common Spanish words.

cards.sentence: Compró un vestido nuevo para la fiesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She bought a new dress for the party.

cards.sentence: Vivimos en un barrio muy tranquilo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We live in a very quiet neighborhood.

cards.sentence: Hay una cruz en la cima de la montaña.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There is a cross on the top of the mountain.

cards.sentence: La hoja del árbol es de color verde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The tree leaf is green.

cards.sentence: A los niños les encanta jugar con burbujas de jabón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Children love to play with soap bubbles.

cards.sentence: Me gusta beber vino tinto con la cena.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to drink red wine with dinner.

cards.sentence: Prefiero la cerveza fría en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I prefer cold beer in summer.

cards.sentence: Ella habla tres lenguas fluidamente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She speaks three languages fluently.

cards.sentence: Le duele el cuello después de dormir mal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His neck hurts after sleeping badly.

cards.sentence: Celebramos el nacimiento de su primer hijo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We celebrated the birth of their first child.

cards.sentence: Espera un segundo, por favor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Wait a second, please.

cards.sentence: Mi abuelo me contaba muchas historias.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My grandfather used to tell me many stories.

cards.sentence: Mi abuela prepara la mejor paella.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My grandmother makes the best paella.

cards.sentence: Mi tío vive en otra ciudad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My uncle lives in another city.

cards.sentence: Mi tía es muy buena cocinera.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My aunt is a very good cook.

cards.sentence: Voy a visitar a mi primo el fin de semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I'm going to visit my cousin this weekend.

cards.sentence: Mi sobrino es muy inteligente.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My nephew is very intelligent.

cards.sentence: Mi sobrina acaba de graduarse.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My niece just graduated.

cards.sentence: Mi suegro nos ayudó con la mudanza.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My father-in-law helped us with the move.

cards.sentence: Mi suegra es muy amable.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My mother-in-law is very kind.

cards.sentence: Mi cuñado trabaja en la misma empresa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My brother-in-law works at the same company.

cards.sentence: Mi cuñada vendrá a visitarnos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My sister-in-law will come to visit us.

cards.sentence: Ella fue con su novio al concierto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She went with her boyfriend to the concert.

cards.sentence: Mi novia y yo viajaremos en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My girlfriend and I will travel in summer.

cards.sentence: Mi esposo es mi mejor amigo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My husband is my best friend.

cards.sentence: Su esposa le preparó una sorpresa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His wife prepared a surprise for him.

cards.sentence: Mi vecino tiene un perro grande.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My neighbor has a big dog.

cards.sentence: Se mudaron a un apartamento más grande.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They moved to a bigger apartment.

cards.sentence: Cenamos en el comedor de la casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We had dinner in the dining room of the house.

cards.sentence: Subimos por la escalera principal.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We went up the main stairs.

cards.sentence: Guarda la ropa en el armario.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He keeps the clothes in the wardrobe.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos una lámpara nueva para la sala.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need a new lamp for the living room.

cards.sentence: Pásame las tijeras, por favor.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Pass me the scissors, please.

cards.sentence: Llevaba una camisa azul clara.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He was wearing a light blue shirt.

cards.sentence: Necesito comprar unos pantalones nuevos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to buy new pants.

cards.sentence: La falda de su vestido es muy larga.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The skirt of her dress is very long.

cards.sentence: Ponte el abrigo, hace frío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Put on your coat, it's cold.

cards.sentence: Perdí mis guantes en el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I lost my gloves in the park.

cards.sentence: Ponte calcetines limpios.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Put on clean socks.

cards.sentence: Necesitamos aceite para cocinar la pasta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We need oil to cook the pasta.

cards.sentence: Compré pan y mantequilla para el desayuno.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I bought bread and butter for breakfast.

cards.sentence: Me encantan las patatas fritas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love french fries.

cards.sentence: Esta sopa lleva mucha cebolla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This soup has a lot of onion.

cards.sentence: El tomate es una fruta, no una verdura.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The tomato is a fruit, not a vegetable.

cards.sentence: Bebí café en mi taza favorita.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I drank coffee in my favorite cup.

cards.sentence: Pagué con tarjeta de crédito.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I paid with a credit card.

cards.sentence: Necesito un billete de tren para Madrid.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a train ticket to Madrid.

cards.sentence: Encontré una moneda antigua en el suelo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I found an old coin on the floor.

cards.sentence: Mi jefe me felicitó por mi trabajo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My boss congratulated me on my work.

cards.sentence: Es el empleado del mes.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He is the employee of the month.

cards.sentence: Mis hijos van a un buen colegio.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My children go to a good school.

cards.sentence: Organizamos una gran fiesta de cumpleaños.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We organized a big birthday party.

cards.sentence: Le compré un regalo para su aniversario.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I bought him a gift for his anniversary.

cards.sentence: Tomaremos el autobús para ir al centro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We will take the bus to go downtown.

cards.sentence: Me gusta pasear en bicicleta por el parque.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to ride my bicycle in the park.

cards.sentence: Nos vemos en el aeropuerto a las cinco.
cards.sentenceTranslation: See you at the airport at five.

cards.sentence: El barco llegó al puerto esta mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The ship arrived at the port this morning.

cards.sentence: Consultamos el mapa para encontrar la dirección.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We consulted the map to find the address.

cards.sentence: Solo me queda uno.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I only have one left.

cards.sentence: Tenemos dos gatos en casa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have two cats at home.

cards.sentence: Conté hasta tres y salí corriendo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I counted to three and ran out.

cards.sentence: Compró cuatro libros nuevos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He bought four new books.

cards.sentence: La reunión empieza a las cinco.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The meeting starts at five.

cards.sentence: Tienen seis hijos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They have six children.

cards.sentence: Son las siete de la tarde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's seven in the evening.

cards.sentence: Hay ocho manzanas en la cesta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are eight apples in the basket.

cards.sentence: El autobús llega a las nueve.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bus arrives at nine.

cards.sentence: Cumplió diez años ayer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He turned ten yesterday.

cards.sentence: Cien personas asistieron al evento.
cards.sentenceTranslation: One hundred people attended the event.

cards.sentence: La distancia es de mil kilómetros.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The distance is one thousand kilometers.

cards.sentence: Este paisaje es muy bonito.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This landscape is very pretty.

cards.sentence: Compré una flor de color morado.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I bought a purple flower.

cards.sentence: Dibujó un círculo perfecto en la pizarra.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He drew a perfect circle on the blackboard.

cards.sentence: La mesa es de forma cuadrada.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The table is square-shaped.

cards.sentence: Aprendimos sobre los triángulos en clase de geometría.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We learned about triangles in geometry class.

cards.sentence: Siente una gran emoción al verla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He feels a great emotion when he sees her.

cards.sentence: Es un hecho que el sol sale por el este.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It is a fact that the sun rises in the east.

cards.sentence: Esta pintura es una obra de arte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This painting is a work of art.

cards.sentence: Admiro la escultura griega antigua.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I admire ancient Greek sculpture.

cards.sentence: Estudió fotografía en la universidad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She studied photography at university.

cards.sentence: Este es un buen sitio para leer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This is a good place to read.

cards.sentence: Conectamos a la red Wi-Fi.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We connected to the Wi-Fi network.

cards.sentence: El movimiento de la Tierra causa el día y la noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The Earth's movement causes day and night.

cards.sentence: Es hora de pasar a la acción.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It's time to take action.

cards.sentence: Necesito más energía para terminar el día.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need more energy to finish the day.

cards.sentence: Toda acción tiene una consecuencia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Every action has a consequence.

cards.sentence: Compró una gran cantidad de fruta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He bought a large quantity of fruit.

cards.sentence: Perdió el tacto en los dedos por el frío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He lost feeling in his fingers due to the cold.

cards.sentence: Su mirada era profunda y pensativa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His gaze was deep and thoughtful.

cards.sentence: Me encantó su sonrisa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I loved her smile.

cards.sentence: Su risa llenó la habitación de alegría.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Her laughter filled the room with joy.

cards.sentence: Escuchó el llanto de un bebé a lo lejos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He heard a baby's crying in the distance.

cards.sentence: Dame un abrazo fuerte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Give me a strong hug.

cards.sentence: Le dio un beso en la mejilla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: She gave him a kiss on the cheek.

cards.sentence: Muchas gracias por tu ayuda.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Thank you very much for your help.

cards.sentence: Nos dijo adiós antes de irse.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He said goodbye to us before leaving.

cards.sentence: Dile hola a tu hermana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Say hello to your sister.

cards.sentence: Mi maestro de historia es muy inspirador.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My history teacher is very inspiring.

cards.sentence: La maestra explicó el ejercicio de nuevo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The teacher explained the exercise again.

cards.sentence: El bebé está durmiendo en su cuna.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The baby is sleeping in its crib.
